04-01-start: Construct (HUD rework build): pale sky, marble floor, three panes ahead with reflections; the middle pane is labelled foot (all panes are labelled foot, not by their app id as before); no HUD while the voice agent is silent; the OPEN CUBE chip of the earlier build is gone.
04-02-walk-forward: w for 1.5 s: the panes grow slightly; walking is slow.
04-03-turn-right: e for 1 s: the view turns right.
04-04-turn-left: q for 1 s: the view turns back.
04-05-fly-in: Return flies into the sunset pane at 1:1; a glass hint Alt Esc Step back shows at the bottom.
04-06-fly-out: Alt+Escape flies back out; a hint bar shows W A S D Walk, Return Fly in, Tab Windows, F1 All keys, Super C Cube.
04-07-terminal: Super+t opens a terminal pane and the camera flies in: the shell fills the whole screen, no HUD hint visible.
04-08-cat: cat friday.md prints the Friday list in the terminal pane.
04-09-terminal-pane: Alt+Escape flies out; the new terminal is a pane among the others and the hint bar shows again.
04-10-window-list: Tab opens a glass window list with thumbnails: six windows, all named foot, with ahead, left, right, behind you. The pane labels do not tell the windows apart.
04-12-list-choice: Return flies to the chosen pane (chora page); the neighbour panes show at the edges.
04-14-keys: F1 opens a glass key overlay with a search field: walk, panes, helper and chat, give a window, everywhere; the panes behind are greyed.
04-15-keys-search: Typing turn narrows the list to 1 key match: Turn left or right, Q E or the arrows.
04-16-keys-cleared: The first Escape clears the search text and keeps the overlay open.
04-16b-keys-closed: The second Escape closes the overlay.
04-17-notice: z does nothing and shows the notice The keys walk here. F1 shows them all. in a pill at the top right.
04-18-hud-sentence: The fake voice agent's sentence shows in the HUD island at the top right: Good morning! Your notes for Friday are ready.
04-19-chat-open: A click on the island opens the chat as a glass panel at the right with the field focused: Chat with a helper, 1 Atlas working, hints Return Send, Ctrl . Stop, Esc Close. A blurred smear of the pane shows through the panel.
04-20-picked: 1 and Return pick Atlas: WORKING, Atlas Tidy notes 1 of 2, the transcript with a bubble for the user line.
04-21-sent: The message is sent; no new bubble for it (the fake agent does not echo it).
04-22-question: The question card: QUESTION FOR YOU, Atlas wants to write the file notes.txt, the path, Alt Y Yes and Alt N No; the field says A question is waiting and the hint Typing does not answer overlaps the field top.
04-23-yes: The click on Yes: the card stays until the agent closes it; no feedback of its own.
04-24-card-closed: After the fake agent's done the card is gone; the chat shows 2 of 2. The field has lost its focus ring.
04-25-stop: Ctrl+. (Stop) shows no change: the header still says WORKING 2 of 2.
04-26-chat-closed: Escape does not close the chat: it stays open (the field no longer has the keyboard after the click on Yes).
